title: Seven students sign the Pledge
text: In an attic room of a stone building in downtown Schenectady — West College, at Union and College streets — seven Union College undergraduates sign a formal pledge to organise a secret society. The Pledge, long kept as a piece of tawny paper in the archives of the Theta, bears the date 24 November 1833.

title: The Theta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 1st chapter, at Union College.

title: The Diamond Badge is first worn in public
text: The badge was designed by Luke F. Newland, a noted Albany jeweller, who had been consulted by a committee including the founder Dr. Charles Washington Harvey.

title: The first Constitution is adopted
text: The Minute Book of the Theta records the adoption of the Fraternity's first Constitution. The signed document was lost for a century and rediscovered in 1936 in the shop of a dealer in old and rare manuscripts; it is now in the archives of the Executive Council.

title: The first initiate
text: John H. E. Beach, class of 1838, becomes the first man initiated after the adoption of the Constitution.

title: The Delta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 2nd chapter, at New York University.

title: The mother chapter takes the name Theta
text: The original chapter adopts the name Theta, at the instance of Maunsell Van Rensselaer, class of 1838, later President of Hobart College. The same year Merwin Henry Stewart becomes the first of the seven founders to die.

title: The Beta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 3rd chapter, at Yale University.

title: The Sigma is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 4th chapter, at Brown University.

title: The first Convention
text: Psi Upsilon holds the first convention of any American fraternity.

title: The Gamma is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 5th chapter, at Amherst College.

title: The Lambda is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 7th chapter, at Columbia University.

title: The Zeta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 6th chapter, at Dartmouth College.

title: The first membership catalogue
text: Psi Upsilon issues the first fraternity membership catalogue.

title: The Kappa is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 8th chapter, at Bowdoin College.

title: The Psi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 9th chapter, at Hamilton College.

title: The Xi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 10th chapter, at Wesleyan University.

title: The first songbook
text: The Fraternity prints the first of its songbooks. Every printed songbook since has carried two epigraphs — one from The Merchant of Venice, and one by Francis M. Finch, Beta 1849, who wrote many of the earliest Psi U songs.

title: The Alpha is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 11th chapter, at Harvard University.

title: The first fraternity magazine
text: Psi Upsilon founds the first fraternity magazine.

title: The Upsilon is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 12th chapter, at University of Rochester.

title: The Iota is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 13th chapter, at Kenyon College.

title: The Phi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 14th chapter, at University of Michigan.

title: The Omega is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 15th chapter, at University of Chicago.

title: The Convention Records begin
text: The earliest Convention Records held in this museum are those of the thirty-ninth annual Convention, held with the Gamma at Amherst College.

title: The Alpha goes inactive
text: After 23 years at Harvard University.

title: The Pi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 16th chapter, at Syracuse University.

title: The Chi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 17th chapter, at Cornell University.

title: The Diamond begins
text: The first number of The Diamond of Psi Upsilon appears. It runs until 1887, is revived in 1920, and continues in print until 2015.

title: Garnet and gold
text: The Fraternity colours are chosen at the Convention of 1878.

title: The Beta Beta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 18th chapter, at Trinity College.

title: A brother becomes President of the United States
text: Chester A. Arthur, Theta 1848, elected Vice President in 1880, becomes President on the assassination of James Garfield. He serves until 1885.

title: The Eta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 19th chapter, at Lehigh University.

title: The Mu is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 21st chapter, at University of Minnesota.

title: The Tau is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 20th chapter, at University of Pennsylvania.

title: The system of heraldry is adopted
text: A committee of Albert P. Jacobs, Phi 1873; Karl P. Harrington, Xi 1882; and George B. Penny, Chi 1885, reported in 1892 on a system of arms for the Fraternity and its chapters. It is adopted at the Convention of 1894. Before this the badge and the colours were the only uniform symbolism Psi Upsilon had.

title: The Rho is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 22nd chapter, at University of Wisconsin.

title: The Epsilon is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 23rd chapter, at University of California, Berkeley.

title: A second brother in the White House
text: William Howard Taft, Beta 1878, becomes President of the United States. He is later Chief Justice of the Supreme Court — the only man to hold both offices — and it was largely at his urging that Psi Upsilon chartered its first chapter outside the United States.

title: The Omicron is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 24th chapter, at University of Illinois.

title: The Delta Delta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 25th chapter, at Williams College.

title: The Theta Theta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 26th chapter, at University of Washington.

title: The Nu is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 27th chapter, at University of Toronto.

title: The Epsilon Phi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 28th chapter, at McGill University.

title: The Beta goes inactive
text: After 95 years at Yale University.

title: The Zeta Zeta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 29th chapter, at University of British Columbia.

title: The first Heisman Trophy
text: Jay Berwanger, Omega 1936, wins the first Heisman Trophy and becomes the first player selected in the first NFL draft.

title: The Annals of Psi Upsilon
text: The Fraternity's centennial history is published in twelve parts. Much of what is known about the founders comes from it.

title: The Epsilon Nu is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 30th chapter, at Michigan State University.

title: The Epsilon Omega is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 31st chapter, at Northwestern University.

title: The Theta Epsilon is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 32nd chapter, at University of Southern California.

title: The Theta Epsilon goes inactive
text: After 12 years at University of Southern California.

title: The Delta Delta goes inactive
text: After 55 years at Williams College.

title: The Gamma Tau is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 34th chapter, at Georgia Institute of Technology.

title: The Nu Alpha is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 33rd chapter, at Washington and Lee University.

title: The Chi Delta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 35th chapter, at Duke University.

title: The Nu Alpha goes inactive
text: After 4 years at Washington and Lee University.

title: The Epsilon Iota is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 37th chapter, at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute.

title: The Phi Beta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 38th chapter, at College of William and Mary.

title: The Kappa Phi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 39th chapter, at Pennsylvania State University.

title: The Beta Kappa is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 40th chapter, at Washington State University.

title: The Beta Alpha is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 41st chapter, at Miami University of Ohio.

title: The Zeta Tau goes inactive
text: After 11 years at Tufts University.

title: The Mu goes inactive
text: After 102 years at University of Minnesota.

title: The Sigma goes inactive
text: After 153 years at Brown University.

title: The Beta Alpha goes inactive
text: After 4 years at Miami University of Ohio.

title: The Phi Delta is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 42nd chapter, at University of Mary Washington.

title: The Epsilon Phi goes inactive
text: After 69 years at McGill University.

title: The Nu goes inactive
text: After 77 years at University of Toronto.

title: The Epsilon goes inactive
text: After 96 years at University of California, Berkeley.

title: The Kappa Phi goes inactive
text: After 9 years at Pennsylvania State University.

title: The Kappa goes inactive
text: After 155 years at Bowdoin College.

title: The Lambda Sigma is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 43rd chapter, at Pepperdine University.

title: The Alpha Omicron is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 44th chapter, at New Jersey Inst. of Technology.

title: The Epsilon Omega goes inactive
text: After 50 years at Northwestern University.

title: The Beta Kappa goes inactive
text: After 12 years at Washington State University.

title: The Sigma Phi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 45th chapter, at St. Francis University.

title: The Delta Nu is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 46th chapter, at Keene State College.

title: The Gamma goes inactive
text: After 169 years at Amherst College.

title: The Iota goes inactive
text: After 150 years at Kenyon College.

title: The Phi Nu is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 47th chapter, at Christopher Newport University.

title: The Lambda goes inactive
text: After 172 years at Columbia University.

title: The Theta Pi is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 48th chapter, at Georgia State University.

title: The Theta goes inactive
text: After 181 years at Union College.

title: The Theta Pi goes inactive
text: After 1 years at Georgia State University.

title: The last printed Diamond
text: The final printed issue of The Diamond appears, closing a run that began in 1878.

title: The Chi goes inactive
text: After 140 years at Cornell University.

title: The Tau Epsilon is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 49th chapter, at Clemson University.

title: The Delta Nu goes inactive
text: After 11 years at Keene State College.

title: The Phi Beta becomes an Owl Club
text: After 36 years at College of William and Mary.

title: The Rho goes inactive
text: After 125 years at University of Wisconsin.

title: The Chi Delta goes inactive
text: After 52 years at Duke University.

title: The Delta Omicron is chartered
text: Psi Upsilon's 50th chapter, at Purdue University.

title: The Omicron goes inactive
text: After 116 years at University of Illinois.
